sonnet.problem: The couch joke turns the LORD's presence in Ezekiel 35:10 into a household scene, with God as the owner sitting on the couch. The comparison puts God in the picture instead of staying on Seir's side of the moment.
sonnet.rule: Comparisons stay on the human side of the moment.

sonnet.problem: The first half of this story card, "Back to how it was AND then some, like getting your old job back with a RAISE," restates Ezekiel 36:11. The choice card right before it (card 14) just asked that same fact ("prosper more than before") and showed its answer. The card repeats that answer and only partly moves the passage forward.
